mapper.select: SELECT Id FROM Equipments WHERE SKEquipmentCode = #{equipmentCode} AND ActiveStatus = 1 AND Deleted = 0

SELECT ISNULL( (SELECT Id FROM Products WHERE ProductCode = #{productCode} AND ActiveStatus = 1 AND Deleted = 0), ISNULL( (SELECT TOP 1 pe.ProductId FROM ProductExtraItems pe INNER JOIN Products p ON pe.ProductId = p.Id WHERE pe.ExtraItemCode = #{productCode} AND pe.ActiveStatus = 1 AND pe.Deleted = 0 AND p.ActiveStatus = 1 AND p.Deleted = 0), 0 ) )
SELECT Id FROM ProductRoutings WHERE ProductId = #{productId} AND ActiveStatus = 1 AND Deleted = 0
SELECT Id, Barcode, ProductId, ProductRoutingId, Status, LastProcessId, NextProcessIds FROM ProductSNs WHERE Barcode = #{barcode} AND Deleted = 0

SELECT prs.ProcessId, prs.Sequence, prs.BarcodeVerify, prs.SequenceVerify, prs.DuplicateVerify, prs.RequiredCount FROM ProductRoutingSteps prs INNER JOIN ProcessEquipments pe ON prs.ProcessId = pe.ProcessId WHERE prs.ProductRouteVersionId = #{routingId} AND pe.EquipmentId = #{equipmentId} AND pe.ActiveStatus = 1 AND pe.Deleted = 0 AND prs.ActiveStatus = 1 AND prs.Deleted = 0 ORDER BY prs.Sequence ASC
SELECT ProcessId, Sequence FROM ProductRoutingSteps WHERE ProductRouteVersionId = #{routingId} AND ActiveStatus = 1 AND Deleted = 0 ORDER BY Sequence ASC
SELECT BarCode, ProcessId, Result, ProductId, ProductRoutingId, EquipmentId, ResultDetail, DataTraceId, CreateTime ,IsReworkVoid FROM StationRecords WHERE BarCode = #{barcode} AND Deleted = 0
SELECT BarcodeRule FROM Products WHERE Id = #{productId} AND Deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ProductSNs (Barcode, ProductId, ProductRoutingId, Status, CreateTime, CreateBy, Deleted) VALUES (#{barcode}, #{productId}, #{routingId}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, 0)

INSERT INTO StationRecords (BarCode, ProductId, ProductRoutingId, ProcessId, EquipmentId, Result, ResultDetail, DataTraceId, CreateTime, Deleted) VALUES (#{barcode}, #{productId}, #{productRoutingId}, #{processId}, #{equipmentId}, #{result}, #{resultDetail}, #{dataTraceId}, #{createTime}, 0)
